864-2225-7507-8043.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
864-2225-7507-8043.description:
Cast Kindred Charge for free due to Vision, choosing a creature type granted by Hivestone, creating a token copy of each creature you control with haste, and setting up a delayed exile trigger.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Eternal Witness token enters, it triggers, returning Kindred Charge from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

232-678-6798.description:
Cast Priest of Urabrask by paying its mana cost.
When Priest of Urabrask enters, it triggers, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Priest of Urabrask.
When Priest of Urabrask dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Priest of Urabrask from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability, causing you to surveil 1.
Repeat.

2104-2707-6005.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Malevolent Chandelier by paying {2}, causing you to put Temporal Manipulation on the bottom of your library from your graveyard.
Move to your next turn, drawing Temporal Manipulation from the bottom of your library due to River Song during your draw step.
Repeat.

339-677-7272-7730.notablePrerequisites: You have at least four card types in your graveyard.
339-677-7272-7730.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Reaper of Flight Moonsilver by sacrificing Jegantha, giving Reaper of Flight Moonsilver +2/+1 until end of turn
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

4828-4832-5261.easyPrerequisites:
Benefactor's Draught is exiled by Isochron Scepter.
Ensoul Artifact is attached to Isochron Scepter.
Isochron Scepter doesn't have summoning sickness.
4828-4832-5261.notablePrerequisites: Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}.

Activate any number of creatures by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Benefactor's Draught without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Benefactor's Draught, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to draw a card
Repeat

5170-5686-6132-8175.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Edgar triggers, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Shilgengar ability, creating a Blood token
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Edgar trigger.
Resolve the Edgar trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability, creating a Blood token
Repeat.

1479-2841-3585-8103.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Verdant Catacombs.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
1479-2841-3585-8103.description:
Fetch a land using Verdant Catacombs.
When the fetched land enters, Greensleeves and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Greensleeves trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Greensleeves from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Greensleeves triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

1510-4574-5849-6495.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Arcbound Stinger.
When Arcbound Stinger dies, its modular ability triggers, putting its +1/+1 counters on Arcbound Reclaimer.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Arcbound Stinger from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast Arcbound Stinger from the top of your library by paying {0} due to Fortune Teller's Talent.
Repeat.
1510-4574-5849-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

1849-2034-6006-6970-7850.description:
Cast Abby from the command zone by paying {1}{R}{G} plus commander tax if applicable.
Abby triggers, creating a number of 1/1 Fungus Zombie creature tokens named Cordyceps Infected equal to the amount of mana spent to cast it.
When Abby enters under an opponent's control, Mirror of Life Trapping triggers, exiling Abby.
Choose to return Abby from exile to the command zone.
Activate two Codryceps Infected tokens by tapping them, adding {R}{G}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Cordyceps Infected token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat step 6 until you have enough mana to cast Abby.
Repeat from step 1.

215-2079-6478.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with toughness 6 or greater.
215-2079-6478.description:
Activate Arbor Adherent by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Arbor Adherent from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Arbor Adherent by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

2921-3249-4647-5173.description:
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast Shambling Ghast card from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Shambling Ghast from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Shambling Ghast.
When Shambling Ghast dies, it triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}
Repeat.

2866-3689-6518-7646.description:
Cast Scrap Trawler by paying {0}.
When Scrap Trawler enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Scrap Trawler and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Workshop Assistant from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Workshop Assistant by paying {0}.
When Workshop Assistant enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Workshop Assistant and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Workshop Assistant dies, it triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1062-3484-5674-7435.notablePrerequisites: You have at least 3 land cards in your hand.
1062-3484-5674-7435.description:
Activate Hardened Academic by discarding a land card.
Slogurk triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Hardened Academic ability.
Repeat from step 1 two additional times.
Activate Slogurk by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
When Slogurk leaves the battlefield, it triggers, returning three land cards from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Slogurk by paying {E} due to Primal Prayers.
When Slogurk enters, Decoction Module triggers, causing you to get {E}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

3259-7297-7357.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-7297-7357.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Pugnacious Pugilist as attackers.
Pugnacious Pugilist triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
If the sacrificed creature was a Devil token, it triggers when it dies, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat each combat phase.

997-2730-5237.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Renegade Rallier.
When Renegade Rallier dies, Kaya's Ghostform triggers, returning Renegade Rallier from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Renegade Rallier enters, it triggers, returning Kaya's Ghostform from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Renegade Rallier
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

4311-4871-5220-6797.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
4311-4871-5220-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
Repeat.

618-6798-6966.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of All-Fates Stalker.
When the All-Fates Stalker token enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Kiki-Jiki until All-Fates Stalker leaves the battlefield.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the All-Fates Stalker token.
When the All-Fates Stalker token dies, Kiki-Jiki is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

339-677-3967-5223.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

2079-2105-3204-4251.notablePrerequisites:
Mysterious Limousine does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
One of Godo or Combat Celebrant must be on the battlefield, with the other exiled by Mysterious Limousine.
2079-2105-3204-4251.description:
Declare either Godo or Combat Celebrant and Mysterious Limousine as attackers.
Mysterious Limousine and either Godo or Combat Celebrant trigger.
Resolve the Godo or Combat Celebrant trigger, untapping Mysterious Limousine and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Mysterious Limousine trigger, exiling Godo or Combat Celebrant from the battlefield, and then returning Godo or Combat Celebrant from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

1789-2511-5649-5929.notablePrerequisites: Leyline of Transformation on the battlefield with "Dragon" chosen.
1789-2511-5649-5929.description:
Cast Bladewing's Thrall by paying {2}{B}{B}.
When Bladewing's Thrall enters the battlefield, Lathliss triggers.
Holding priority, activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Bladewing's Thrall.
Resolve the Lathliss trigger, creating a 5/5 Dragon creature token.
When the Dragon enters the battlefield, Bladewing's Thrall triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Ayara, Widow of the Realm // Ayara, Furnace Queen

2923-3492-3609.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Ayara triggers, returning Coretapper from your graveyard to the battlefield and giving it haste until end of turn.
Activate Coretapper's first ability by tapping it, putting a charge counter on Magistrate's Scepter.
Activate Coretapper's second ability by sacrificing it, putting two charge counters on Magistrate's Scepter.
Activate Magistrate's Scepter's second ability by tapping it and removing three charge counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

1799-2034-3862-5795.notablePrerequisites: You do not control an Army.
1799-2034-3862-5795.description:
Activate Barkform Harvester by paying {2}, putting Orcish Bowmasters on the bottom of your library from your graveyard.
Activate Grenzo by paying {2}, putting Orcish Bowmasters into your graveyard from the bottom of your library, and then putting it onto the battlefield.
When Orcish Bowmasters enters the battlefield, it triggers, dealing 1 damage to any target, then creating a 0/0 Orc Army creature token and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the Army and Orcish Bowmasters, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

1050-5131-5773.notablePrerequisites: You have not cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1050-5131-5773.description:
Activate Spearbreaker Behemoth by paying {1}, giving Muldrotha indestructible until end of turn.
Activate Nevinyrral's Disk by paying {1} and tapping it, destroying all artifacts, creatures and enchantments.
Cast Nevinyrral's Disk from your graveyard by paying {4}.
Repeat during each of your turns.

997-1339-3284.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
997-1339-3284.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing another creature.
Korvold's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, causing you to create a 1/1 Insect creature token with haste.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat.

2068-4283-4894.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional nontoken creature.
You have at least one creature card in your graveyard.
Whisper does not have summoning sickness.
2068-4283-4894.description:
Activate Whisper by tapping it, sacrificing Breaching Hippocamp and any other creature you control, targeting any other creature card in your graveyard.
Ashnod the Uncaring triggers, copying Whisper's ability, targeting Breaching Hippocamp.
Resolve the copy of Whisper's ability, returning Breaching Hippocamp from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Breaching Hippocamp enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Whisper.
Resolve the original Whisper ability, returning the targeted creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2178-3484-4023-4840-5256.notablePrerequisites:
Dr Madison Li does not have summoning sickness.
Thornbite Staff attached to Dr Madison Li.
You have at least five energy counters.
2178-3484-4023-4840-5256.description:
Activate Dr Madison Li's third ability by tapping it and paying {E}{E}{E}{E}{E}, returning Myr Battlesphere from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Myr Battlepshere enters the battlefield, it and Decoction Module trigger.
Resolve the Myr Battlesphere trigger, creating four 1/1 Myr artifact creature tokens.
When the Myrs enter the battlefield, Decoction Module triggers four times.
Resolve all Decoction Module triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}{E}{E}.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Myr Battlesphere.
When Myr Battlesphere dies, Dr Madison Li triggers, untapping itself.Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to Myr Battlesphere's power.
Repeat.

1218-1819-2503.notablePrerequisites: You have at least ten creature cards in your graveyard.
1218-1819-2503.description:
Cast Tainted Strike by paying {B}, giving Syr Konrad +1/+0 and infect until end of turn.
Cast Inverter of Truth by paying {2}{B}{B}.
When Inverter of Truth enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling your library and then shuffling your graveyard into your library.
Syr Konrad triggers for each creature card that left your graveyard this way, giving each opponent that many poison counters.
Each opponent loses the game due to having ten or more poison counters.

1110-2292-2906-2931.notablePrerequisites: You are able to cast Faceless One for {0} due to Rakdos.

Cast Faceless One from the command zone by paying {0}.
Terror of the Peaks triggers, dealing 3 damage to any target opponent.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Faceless One.
Choose to have Faceless One return to command zone.
Resolve the Viscera Seer's ability, scrying one.
Repeat.

During any opponent's turn, activate Budoka Gardener by tapping it, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters the battlefield, Retreat to Coralhelm triggers, untapping Budoka Gardener.
Activate Ghost Town's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
